name: Scarcity Isle
intro: ✨ Welcome to Scarcity Isle, where every wish counts!
This tiny island in the sky is yours. Your goal: grow it from almost nothing into a home. To see your goals, open your wish watch and press 📖 What do I do now?
First, open the chest. Put the ice down on your island and break it: it melts into water.
Then pour the lava with two empty blocks between it and the water, and dig a hole in the gap next to the water. Where they meet, cobblestone appears. Mine it, and it comes back!
Careful: keep lava away from your tree, never pour water on top of the lava, and don't dig away all your dirt. Below the island is the void.
Break leaves for saplings and plant them on dirt to grow more trees. Your Isle Guide book tells you more.
Stuck? Open your wish watch and press 📖 What do I do now? for hints. Wishes are scarce here, so choose them well. Type /moddy wishes to see how many you have.

book.title: Isle Guide
book.author: Moddy
pages:
Welcome to
Scarcity Isle!

This tiny island in the sky is yours.

Your goal: grow it from almost nothing into a home.

To see your goals, open your wish watch and press 📖 What do I do now?

Your first steps

1. Open the chest. It has ice and lava.

2. Put the ice on your island and break it. It melts into water!

3. Leave two empty blocks next to the water, then pour the lava.

4. Dig a hole in the gap, next to the water.

Where they meet, cobblestone appears.

Mine the cobblestone and more comes back, again and again. That is your cobblestone generator!

Use the stone for tools, a furnace and more island.

Be careful

Keep lava away from your tree. It burns wood.

Never pour water on top of the lava. It turns into obsidian and your lava is gone.

Don't fall off the edge!

Trees and food

Punch the tree for wood. Make planks, sticks, a crafting table and a pickaxe.

Break leaves for saplings and apples. Plant saplings on dirt.

Animals

Make a patch of grass, then go 24 to 48 blocks away and wait. Animals can appear on the grass.

Keep your last dirt. Without it, nothing grows.

Sky island tricks

Sand: when a husk (a desert zombie) is beaten while it is on fire, the dirt under it turns into sand.

Iron: hit a mob wearing an iron chestplate. It can break and drop an iron ingot.

Zombies sometimes drop iron too.
Amethyst: surround a 2x2x2 cube of packed ice with lava, with four lava sources on top. It turns into a geode!

The Nether

The Nether has a small island of its own, with obsidian, soul sand and nether wart.

To get there, build a portal. Your goal list shows how.

Your wishes

You start with {bank_start} wishes. One more every {bank_refill_minutes} minutes, up to {bank_cap}. A wish costs {bank_price}; a ready-made one, half.

/moddy wishes

What Moddy does here

Moddy helps on your own island. He keeps gifts small: short flights, short powers, a stack at a time.

Wishes don't work in the Nether.

Wishes that help

Wish for what you need, then do the rest yourself:

some cobblestone
a water wand
some raw iron
two cows
a spooky monster cave

Stuck?

Open your wish watch and press "📖 What do I do now?". It shows your goals and their hints.

Wish Magicians can ask Moddy a question, like "how do I get sand?" Questions are free!

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/root.hint: Punch your tree until a block of wood pops out.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/wood.hint: Punch your tree until a block of wood pops out. Bone meal grows a sapling into a tree.

minecraft:story/root.hint: Turn wood into planks, then make a crafting table from four planks.

minecraft:story/mine_stone.hint: Make sticks from planks, then a wooden pickaxe at your crafting table.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/cobble_ge.hint: Water and lava with two empty blocks between them, and a hole in the gap next to the water. Mine the cobblestone they make. Lost your water? A water wand puts it back.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/sapling.hint: Break leaves on your tree until a sapling drops, then plant it on dirt. Bone meal grows more trees.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/apple.hint: Oak leaves sometimes drop an apple when you break them. More trees, more leaves.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/furnace.hint: Eight cobblestone in a ring at your crafting table make a furnace.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/charcoal.hint: Smelt oak logs in your furnace and they turn into charcoal.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/torch.hint: A stick on top of a piece of coal or charcoal makes four torches.

minecraft:story/upgrade_tools.hint: Three cobblestone and two sticks make a stone pickaxe.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/farm.hint: Make a hoe from planks and sticks, then till dirt next to water.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/mob_farm.hint: Monsters appear in the dark. Beat one!

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/zombie_hu.hint: Zombies come out in the dark. Beat one!

minecraft:story/smelt_iron.hint: Smelt raw iron in your furnace to make an iron ingot. Zombies sometimes drop iron too.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/cauldron.hint: Seven iron ingots in a U at your crafting table make a cauldron.

minecraft:story/lava_bucket.hint: Pointed dripstone hanging under a block with lava on top drips lava into a cauldron below.

skyvoid_advancements:overworld/passive_a.hint: Two animals and their favourite food: feed them both and a baby appears.

_notes: The Isle's world manifest, as the level jar ships it: what a world made with World Type "Moddy Isle" reads (its islands' spacing, its first-join words, its guide book and goal list, its Builder settings, its datapack defaults). islands.spacing turns on one island per player, 1024 blocks apart; it is fixed once the first island exists (islands.json records it). creation.datapacks are the built-in SkyBlock packs the World Type ticks; level_type stays minecraft:normal because Standard SkyBlock overrides the overworld's own worldgen. people.islandGuard sends a player standing in another player's island cell home. crafters.builder: ruleScope own_island because set_rule cannot scope a rule to one island, so the Builder offers no rules here. A server's own launcher may add server settings on top of this file; none of them are needed to play.
